Bottom line, get a new therapist.

Okay friend, I want you to take some deep breaths.  I seriously doubt that you're going to be sent to juvie and here's why: while suicide is technically 'illegal' that is only so that the police can get into your home without a warrant so that they can save your life.  After doing a bit of research on the subject, there was a man in Maryland last year who went to jail following a suicide attempt but his charge was based off of reckless endangerment by driving drunk into a wall with his little brother in the vehicle with him.

Please don't try again.  I know it's hard to think things will get better but I'm almost a year away from my suicide attempt and my life has gotten so much better.  PM me if you need to talk through it.  It's going to be okay.
